Commentary.Commentary: The two pacers were excellent for Pakistan with Amir clearly being the standout bowler although it was Wahab who was more successful. The spinners failed to create much impact mainly due to lack of accuracy in their spells. The spin trio combined scalped just two wickets which tells the story for Pakistan. The track hasn't crumbled just yet but this lead is handy. The Pakistan 2nd innings isn't far away.

A good batting performance by West Indies as they manage to get a lead of 56. Their innings largely revolved around a superb ton from Brathwaite who carried his bat. He got able support from the middle and lower order as the visitors managed to frustrate Pakistan with a dogged batting performance. Like Pakistan, West Indies too were guilty of gifting wickets to loose shots.

Gabriel goes for the review almost as an afterthought. Replays confirm that there is a slight edge. The on-field call will stay as it it. 2ND TEST FIFER FOR WAHAB. It's been a lion-hearted performance from him in this innings. WI HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 337.

.....DAY 3, SESSION 2.....

The hosts have only themselves to blame as they have given lives to Brathwaite and Bishoo. The track has behaved normally till now although there has been slight help for the accurate bowlers. As the lead grows, pressure will mount on Pakistan. Join us in a while for the second session.

PITCH REPORT - Bazid Khan reckons that the track hasn't deteriorated as much as it usually does on a third day pitch. There would be some turn but it would be slow due to the lack of pace in the surface. Feels that it's another batting day unless the batsmen gift their wickets away like the previous two days. Opines that the key to getting runs to keep things simple - play straight and treat each ball on its merit.

Hello and welcome to day 3 of the final Test between Pakistan and West Indies in Sharjah. The match is in the balance with the visitors marginally in front as the deficit is only 37 with four wickets in hand. However, Pakistan know that they are almost into the Windies tail. So, whoever wins this session would have their noses in front in this Test. The action isn't far away.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 1....

West Indies are still trailing but the deficit is narrowing down. If and when they get the lead, the pressure will start mounting on Pakistan as this track is definitely crumbling. A huge first session in prospect tomorrow as both sides are bound to wrestle for that important first innings lead. Do join us at 1130 IST for the third day's play. Till then, it's goodbye from us.

Pakistan's bowling after the new ball phase was disappointing. Barring Amir, none of them looked threatening although Wahab did get a couple of wickets. The latter struggled with his followthrough as well as landing area as usual. Yasir Shah had an off day as he struggled to get the radar right while his spin partner Zulfiqar Babar wasn't allowed to settle either. Despite all this, by making timely strikes, they ensured that West Indies didn't run away with the game.

Another fairly good day for West Indies although the game is still in the balance. After wrapping up the last two Pakistan wickets quickly in the morning, the tourists didn't start off well. They lost early wickets and were 68/4 but Brathwaite combined with the middle order to rescue them. He is unbeaten on 95 and was the highlight of the day while both Chase and Dowrich provided good support to the opener. The trio's efforts meant that the visitors stayed in the game, probably ending the day as the slightly happier side, trailing by only 37 runs.
The light meter is out. The two umpires are having a chat and that should be it for the day. It is STUMPS ON DAY 2!

Shorter on middle, Dowrich goes back and works it to deep square leg for a single.
Shorter on middle and leg, Dowrich goes back and pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a single.
Very wide outside leg, turned through mid-wicket.
EDGED! Floated on middle, turns away, Dowrich defends it off the outer half down to third man for a couple.
Dowrich comes down and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Outside leg, Dowrich comes forward and defends it.
Floated outside leg, swept to short fine leg.
Fuller on off, Brathwaite comes forward and pushes it back down the wicket.
Touch short on off, Brathwaite stay back and defends it.
Floated on off, Brathwaite comes forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter on off, Brathwaite defends it back.
Dowrich takes a single with a push through mid off.
SIX! What a shot! Floated on off and middle, Dowrich comes down the wicket and lofts it up and over the long off fence for a maximum. That was superbly hit!
Shorter one, Brathwaite goes back to cut it hard but finds the fielder at point.
Flatter on the pads, Brathwaite ticks it towards short fine leg.
Brathwaite comes forward and defends it.
On leg, Dowrich defends it off the outer half through third man for a run.
Landed outside leg, tucked towards square leg for a quick single.
Floated outside leg, turned towards short fine leg.
Bowls it on off, pushed back down the wicket to the bowler.
Landed outside off, Dowrich comes forward and defends it.
Turns it through mid on for a single.
Another one on the stumps, Brathwaite blocks it out.
Plays this one back down the wicket.
Floated on middle, Brathwaite comes forward and defends it.
Flatter on off, Brathwaite goes back and places it towards backward point for a single.
Bowls it outside leg, spins in sharply, Brathwaite is a touch opened up but he does well to defend it back down the wicket. The ball just rolls past the stumps.
Azhar and Misbah are having a chat about the field.
Goes back and turns it behind square on the leg for a single.
Dowrich again stays back and tucks it towards the on side.
Bowls it on leg, Dowrich stays back and defends it.
Outside leg, Brathwaite comes forward and pushes it to covers for a single.
Comes forward and turns it towards mid-wicket off his crease.

FOUR! Chance gone! Fuller on middle, Dowrich comes down and lofts it over Yasir Shah at mid on for a boundary. Misbah is not happy, he thinks Yasir should have got to that one. Dowrich is playing his shots for some reason here. The 50-run stand is up as well!
Gets this one to straighten a touch after pitching, Dowrich looks to play at it and is beaten.
Comes down and drives it to the left of Babar who stops the ball.
Around off, Dowrich pushes it towards the off side.
Dowrich comes forward and defends it.
Dowrich cuts it through covers for a single.
Turns this one towards the on side off his crease.
Pushes this one to covers off his crease.
Flighted on the pads, Dowrich comes forward and defends it.
Fuller on middle and leg, Dowrich keeps it out.

DROPPED! Floated outside leg, Dowrich is playing his shots, he goes for the sweep. The ball lobs towards Younis Khan at first slip who has three attempts to take that one but cannot hold onto it. Replays show it came of the pads and then hit the bat and that made the ball lob.
Fuller on middle, Dowrich comes down to have a go all of a sudden. Gets an inside edge through backward square for a single. Not sure, if there was a need for that shot.
Dowrich stays in his crease and defends it.
On middle and leg, Dowrich stays back and turns it to mid on.
Fuller outside off, pushed down to long off for a run.
Floated on middle, Brathwaite comes forward and defends it.
Shorter outside off, Brathwaite goes back and cuts it to point.
Too full outside off, Brathwaite comes down and hits it to long off for a single.
Floated outside off, driven nicely through covers for a single.
Pulls this one through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, left alone by Brathwaite.
Shorter outside off, placed down to third man for a single.
Floated outside off, driven through mid off.
AZHAR ALI into the attack. Yasir Shah was having some work being done on his arm, he seems to have hurt his shoulder. He is off the field.
DRINKS!
Floated on middle and off, Kraigg defends it well off the back foot.
Flatter on middle and leg, KB tickles it down to fine leg deftly to pick up a brace.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Slider on middle, KB gets back and clips it to the leg side.
Quicker ball on leg stump, worked off the back foot down to fine leg for a brace.
Fuller on middle, defended well off the front foot to the bowler.
ZULFIQAR BABAR is back on.
Shortish outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
Full and wide outside off, Dowrich leans forward and drives it through point for a brace. Yasir tidies up near the ropes.
Short on middle and leg, Brathwaite goes back on his toes and clips it to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Dowrich gets back and tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length on middle, worked off the back foot through square leg for a single.

WICKET OFF A NO BALL! Frustration for Pakistan! Full and outside off, angling in, loose drive from Dowrich and gets a thick edge that flies straight into Shafiq's hands at gully. The no ball call had hardly been made by the umpire.
Shortish outside off, blocked off the back foot towards mid on.
Quicker ball outside off, Brathwaite defends it off the front foot.
Flatter outside off, defended well from the crease.
Flatter on middle and leg, Dowrich goes back and pulls it away to mid on for a single.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! A bit short and outside off, width on offer and Dowrich gets back to slap it away square of the wicket to the fence for a boundary.
Floated outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller outside off, driven firmly towards mid off.
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Short on middle and leg, Brathwaite goes back to that one and swivels to pull it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary. Another really good stroke.

Short ball on middle and leg, Brathwaite looks to pull as the ball goes through to Sarfraz. Stifled appeal for a catch but not given. Didn't seem like there was an edge and Pakistan aren't confident enough to review it either.
FOUR! NICELY DONE! Shortish around leg stump, Brathwaite gets back and clips it sweetly down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Rode the bounce really well.
Length ball on off, Brathwaite gets back and blocks it out to the leg side.
No ball! Fuller outside off, defended off the front foot.
Short and outside off, Brathwaite goes back to fend it midair. The ball whizzes away well past him.
Fuller on middle and leg, Dowrich works it towards mid on.
Loopy just outside off, gets the stride in and pushes it towards point.
Drifting in from outside off, extra bounce as Shane cuts it towards point.
On a length outside off, Dowrich gets back and cuts it straight to point.
Floated leg break outside off, Dowrich pushes it with the turn towards cover.
Full toss outside off, Dowrich drills it to the covers but cannot get it to the deep. A quick single taken.
Full toss outside off, SD gets forward and drives it towards cover.
Short of a length around off, Brathwaite gets behind the line and fends it to cover.
Shortish outside off, Dowrich gets back and steers it between point and gully for a brace.
Good length outside off, defended well from the crease.
Shortish on middle and leg, worked off the back foot past short leg for a single.
Wahab has already been warned once officially for running on the danger area of the pitch.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot to point.
A bit short outside off, stays back to cut but mistimes it to the off side.
Tossed up outside off, Dowrich leans into it and smothers it on to the track.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and defends it towards the covers.
Drifting away outside off, spinning away as Dowrich leaves it alone.
Drops it short on middle, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller and on off, driven back past the bowler to the left of the mid on fielder.
Full outside off, Dowrich gets well forward and blocks it to cover.
Full and outside off, driven firmly to the covers where the fielder gets a hand on it to make a half-stop. Single taken.
Full and well wide outside off, loose drive from Dowrich and he's beaten.
Back of a length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Shortish on off, Dworich stays back and blocks it out.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
WAHAB RIAZ is back on for another spell.
Fuller on middle and leg, gets across to that one and smothers it.
Drifting in from outside off, SD gets across and pushes it to cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.

FOUR! PUNISHED! Drops it short outside off, Dowrich sits back to that one and cuts it away through point for a boundary. He was quick to pounce on the bad ball there. Important for the tourists to stay positive.
Flatter outside off, blocked off the back foot to the covers.
Full and around off, defended off the front foot towards cover.
Pitched up outside off, Brathwaite gets well forward and blocks it solidly.
Full and outside off, KB gets the stride in and defends it well.
Length ball outside off, Brathwaite hangs back and pushes it towards cover.
Full and on leg stump, KB gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite gets on the front foot and defends it well.
Good length angled away outside off, Brathwaite gets back and jabs it to the off side.
Fuller on middle, dug out off the inside half of the blade to mid on.
Loopy leg break outside off, spinning away sharply as Dowrich leaves it alone.
Drifting in on off, Dowrich gets on the front foot and defends it well.
Floated on middle, gets across and drives it towards mid on.
Flighted on off, Dowrich leans into it and smothers it to the ground.
Tossed up outside off, steps out and drives it towards mid off for a single.
Full toss outside off, Dowrich punches it firmly towards mid off.
Good length angled away just outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Full and around off, defended well off the front foot towards cover.
Back of a length outside off, Dowrich gets back and punches it to the covers for a single.
Length ball outside off, Dowrich defends it well from the crease.
Good length outside off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.
Loopy on a length on off, pushed off the back foot to point.
Tossed up on middle, Brathwaite steps out to drive but it's too full. Squeezes it to short cover.
A bit short outside off, KB sits back and cuts it towards point.
Fuller on middle, Brathwaite bunts it straight back to the bowler.
FOUR! DEFT TOUCH! Floated outside leg, Brathwaite gets across and clips it away nicely down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Glanced it very delicately to perfection.
A bit short outside off, cut away towards the covers.
Full outside off, Dowrich gets forward and defends it towards cover.
Length ball outside off, blocked off the back foot to the covers.
Full and angling away from well outside off, left alone to the keeper.
SHANE DOWRICH is the new man in for West Indies. He missed the last Test due to injury.

OUT! AMIR BREAKS THE STAND! Another batsman gifts away a start on this track. Full and angling away outside off, Chase goes for a flashy drive without moving his feet. Gets a thick outside edge that is taken sharply by Younis at first slip. The blooming partnership has been broken and Pakistan now sense an opening. Chase will be disappointed as he was batting so well.
Back of a length outside off, steered towards backward point where Yasir makes a diving stop.
Length ball on off, defended off the back foot down the track.
Tossed up outside leg, Chase gets forward and blocks it out.
Maiden Test fifty for Roston Chase!

SIX! KABOOM! Chase goes big! Flighted outside leg, makes room and gets to the pitch of the ball before launching it cleanly over long on for a maximum. Struck it as clean as a whistle. This has been an enterprising knock so far.
Slider around leg stump, worked off the back foot to the leg side.
Tossed up around leg stump, Chase gets forward and jams it to mid on.
Floated on middle, Brathwaite skips down the track and drives it down to long on for a single.
Flatter around leg stump, worked away through backward square leg for a single.
YASIR SHAH to bowl from the other end.
On a length outside off, blocked off the back foot towards point.
Good length angled in on off, Brathwaite gets across and fends it on to the pitch.
Length ball angled in from outside off, Brathwaite defends it well from the crease.
Full and outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
No ball! Good length angled in on off, blocked off the back foot to the leg side. Amir has overstepped, that's a no ball.
Full and outside off, Brathwaite drives it well towards point where Yasir makes a diving stop to his right.
Length ball angled in from outside off, stays in the crease and pushes it towards cover.

Welcome back for the final session of the day. A seesaw match so far with both teams exchanging blows. The game is in the balance at the moment and this passage of play till stumps will be vital. The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. MOHAMMAD AMIR to start proceedings after tea.
.....DAY 2, SESSION 3.....

There has been little help for the bowlers and the home side will know any lead on this deck will be handy. They have tried a lot of things in the session but they have not worked yet. They will hope for more wickets in the final session to stay in the game. Do join us for the final session in a while.

A good session for West Indies! They have played their shots, scoring 103 runs losing just the one wicket. Blackwood fell to Amir but Pakistan have been made to wait after that with a fine stand between Chase and the opener, Brathwaite. The latter carried his good form to register a fine fifty and they will hope to build on this stand to ensure that the visitors have a good score first up.
The googly around off, defended well off the back foot to the leg side. THAT SHALL BE TEA ON DAY 2.
Tossed up outside off, KB uses his feet and drills it down the ground to long off for a single.
Loopy on leg stump, gets across and blocks it to the left of the short leg fielder.
Tossed up outside off, Brathwaite gets forward and defends it to short cover.
Full toss well outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Tossed up outside off, drilled down the ground to long off for a single.
AZHAR ALI comes on to bowl.
Floated around off, Chase defends it firmly from the crease.
Quicker ball outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Fuller outside off, Chase reaches out and defends it well.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Speared in on middle, Chase leans into it and sweetly drives it down the ground past mid on to find the fence. Authoritative stroke.
Floated on middle, Chase works it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter outside off, defended off the front foot towards point.
Floated outside off, Brathwaite gets back and taps it to the off side.
Tossed up on leg stump, Brathwaite steps out to play the booming drive but finds the man at mid on.
Floated on the pads, Chase flicks it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on the pads, Chase wrists it away in front of square to get a brace. Good running!
Very full on middle, Chase digs it out back to the bowler.
Tossed up around leg stump, Brathwaite works it to the leg side for a single.

FOUR! NICELY PLAYED! Flatter outside off, Chase opens the bat face late to steer it to third man. The ball goes off the outer half well past slip to the fence for a boundary. He was in control although it didn't come off the middle of the bat.
Fuller on off, defended well off the front foot towards cover.
Quicker outside off, punched off the back foot towards mid on.
Flighted outside off, Chase drives it firmly back to Nawaz who makes a diving stop.
Full toss and KB sweeps it down to fine leg for a single.
Flatter outside off, blocked solidly off the back foot as Nawaz stops it moving to his left.
Flighted on middle, Brathwaite uses his feet and makes room to pump it down to long off for another single.
Loopy and outside off, Chase steps out to that one and drills it down the ground to long off for a single.
Fuller outside off, Chase gets on the front foot and defends it well.
RIPPER! Flighted outside leg, Brathwaite looks to play at it but is squared up totally by the sharp turn. The ball lobs off the pad and past first slip. A leg bye taken.
Drifting in from around leg stump, Chase reaches out to flick but gets a leading edge towards cover. Single taken.
Floated around leg stump, Chase drives it back to the bowler.
Full on off, Kraigg jams it out towards mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite reaches out to that one and defends it.
Tossed up outside off, KB lunges into it and defends it well.
Drifting away outside off, Chase pushes it to cover for a single.
12th Test fifty for Kraigg Brathwaite!
Fuller ball and Brathwaite drills it down the ground to mid on for a single. It's been a gritty knock from the opener so far.
Fuller on middle, worked away to the leg side.
50-run stand between Chase and Brathwaite.
FOUR! FINDS THE GAP THIS TIME! Full and outside off, Chase reaches out to that one and thumps it emphatically through the covers. Lovely timing as the ball races away to the fence in a flash.
Loopy outside off, Chase drives but straight to the man at short cover.
Flatter and short outside off, cut away towards point where Shafiq makes a really good stop. Prevented a certain boundary there. Single taken.
Drifting fuller on off, Brathwaite steps out to drive but once again cannot quite get underneath that one. Squeezes it to cover.
Tossed up outside off, Brathwaite steps out and drives but straight back to the bowler.
Floated outside off, fluent drive from Chase towards short cover where the fielder gets a hand to it. Parries it down to long off for a run.
Quicker ball on middle and leg, worked towards forward short leg.
Floated outside off, Brathwaite gets well forward and blocks it out nicely.
A bit short outside off, Chase punched off the back foot towards cover. Single taken.
Slider outside off, Chase gets on the front foot and blocks it with a straight bat.
Flatter on off, Chase hangs back and whips it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter outside off, Chase gets well forward and blocks it to the covers.
MOHAMMAD NAWAZ comes on for the first time in the innings.
On middle and off, Chase wrists it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Good ball! Leg break on middle, spins away with bounce. Chase plays it well though by pushing at it with soft hands.
Floated on middle, Chase walks across the stumps to whip it away but gets a leading edge towards cover. He needs to tone down his aggression.
Loopy on a length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Tossed up outside off, nice flowing drive towards cover off the front foot.
Drifting in from around off, Chase lunges into it to block but the ball goes off the inside half to short mid-wicket.
YASIR SHAH comes back on.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
A bouncer down the leg side, Brathwaite easily evades it.
Length ball on middle and leg, worked towards short leg.
There is a man at wide slip now.

FOUR! CLEVER BATTING! Back of a length outside off, Brathwaite plays it with an angled bat. Risky shot usually but with nobody in the slips, it is a percentage stroke. The outside edge flies down to the third man fence.
Back of a length outside off, nicely punched off the back foot towards cover-point for a single.
Dug in short around leg, angling in sharply as Chase manages to get out of the way of the bumper. The short ball leg trap is being set.
Quicker ball on middle, Brathwaite stays back and blocks it well.
Loopy outside off, Chase uses his feet and thumps it down the ground to long off for a single.
Floated outside off, Chase reaches out and blocks it out.
Drifting in from outside off, Chase defends it well from the crease.
FOUR! BANG! Top shot! Floated on middle and off, Chase goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it away cleanly over mid-wicket. Good positive intent from Chase, he seems to be decisive in his footwork.
Flatter on off, punched off the back foot towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! THAT WAS CLOSE! Back of a length on leg stump, Brathwaite gets across to clip it but cannot quite keep the shot down. The ball flies off the glove between Sarfraz and Younis towards the fine leg fence. Both of them couldn't react in time and left it for each other. 100 up for WI.
Short of a length on middle, Brathwaite swivels to pull but goes off the pads towards Younis at leg slip.
Low full toss on off, dug out towards gully where Shafiq makes a diving stop to his right.
Short of a length around off, Brathwaite gets back and across to fend it to short leg.
Dug in short down the leg side, Chase ducks under the bumper.
Back of a length on middle and leg, glanced down to fine leg for a single.
Flighted on a length around off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.
Flatter down the leg side, Brathwaite looks to flick but is rapped on the pads.
Drifting in around off, Brathwaite skips down the track and taps it to short cover.
Tossed up fuller outside off, Kraigg steps out and jams it to the left of the bowler.
Drifting in on off, KB steps out and pushes it down the track to the bowler.
Flatter outside off, pushed off the back foot towards the bowler.
Length ball on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side.
Attempted slower ball slips out of Wahab's hand. Turns into a full toss as Chase pushes it with soft hands towards gully.
Length ball outside off, defended off the back foot towards cover.
On a length outside off, angling in, Chase gets on the back foot to block it.
Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Full and outside off, driven off the front foot towards point. Single taken.
No ball! Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point. Wahab has overstepped and that's a no ball.
DRINKS!
Quicker on off, Chase punches it to mid-wicket. Maiden from Babar!
Outside off, Chase drives it to mid off coming down the wicket.
Fuller outside off, Chase drives it to Misbah at short cover.
Bowls it outside off, Chase pushes it to covers.
Chase gets forward and pushes off the inner half towards the on side.
Flatter on middle and leg, Chase fails to clip it through. Stifled appeal turned down.
FOUR! On a length on middle, Brathwaite gets across to fend it but gets it down to the fine leg fence off the inner half of the bat.
Good length outside off, Brathwaite punches it to covers.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite pushes it towards point off the crease.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards covers by Brathwaite.
Fuller on off, Brathwaite punches it through mid on for  couple of runs. That was nicely timed.
Good length outside off, Brathwaite defends it off his crease.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite comes down and pushes it towards mid off. Babar gets a hand to it going to his right in his followthrough, the ball deflects towards mid on and they take a single.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Flatter on middle, tucked towards the on side.
Floated on off and middle, Brathwaite comes down and pushes it back to the bowler.
Brathwaite comes forward and defends it back down the wicket.
Shorter on middle, Brathwaite looks to work it through mid-wicket but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
A silly mid on in place.
Bouncer! This one is dug in short on middle and leg, Chase ducks under it.
On a length worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls it a touch short on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length outside off, defended back.
On a length outside off, Chase defends it back down the wicket.
Fuller on the pads, clipped to deep square leg for a single.
WAHAB RIAZ comes back on for a bowl.
Fuller on middle, clipped through fine leg for a couple of runs.
Too full on middle, played back down the wicket by Chase.
Comes forward and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Chase comes forward and defends it.
Fuller on middle, Chase works it towards mid-wicket. That came off the inner half.
Fuller on middle, worked through mid on for a single.
Angled on a length on off, Chase defends it towards the on side.
A shorter length ball outside off, Chase lets it go through.
Fuller outside off, Chase comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Fuller and angling into the stumps, Chase drives it back forward.
Bowls a massive no ball, Amir! Length ball on off, Chase defends it towards point. No ball signaled.
On a length again outside off, Chase shoulders his arms to it.
Stays around the wicket, bowls it on a length outside off, no shot offered by Chase.
Chase turns this towards wide mide on where the fielder gets across and stops it to keep them to a single.
Floated on off, Chase comes forward and defends it towards square leg off the inside edge.
A touch fuller on off, pushed to covers by Chase.
Chase comes forward and defends it, that came off the splice of the bat.
FOUR! Nicely done! Floated outside off, Chase gets on top of it and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Flatter on off, defended back down the wicket.
Outside off, Brathwaite comes forward and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite comes forward and defends it.
On a length on middle, Chase gets across and clips it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! HOOKED! Shorter length on middle, Chase gets on top of it and hooks it through fine leg for a boundary.
Good length on off, Chase defends it back down the wicket.
On a length outside off, left alone.
Defended back down the wicket.
Floated on middle, Chase turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Chase drives it back down the wicket.

Floated outside off, Brathwaite comes down, takes it on the full and drives it through mid off for a single.
ROSTON CHASE is the new man in.

Good length outside off, Blackwood defends it off the outer half of the bat.
BOUNCER! Shorter in length on middle, Blackwood ducks under it.
Back of a length outside off, Blackwood defends it back down the wicket off the inside edge.
Holds the length back, Amir. On a lenth on off and middle, Blackwood defends it.
FOUR! SLAPPED! Outside off on a length, Blackwood slaps it hard past Misbah at covers for a boundary. That flew to the ropes.
Change of ends for AMIR!
Looks to attack at first, come down and then pushes this one back down the wicket.
Much better! Tossed up on middle, Brathwaite defends it off the outer half towards covers.
Floated on off, Brathwaite comes forward and mistimes his push.
Drops it short on off, punched through mid on for a single again. Babar needs to flight it up.
This one comes in with the arm on middle, Brathwaite punches it down to long on for a single.l
Flatter outside off, defended off the back foot.
BABAR into the attack again.
FOUR! Hit away! Tossed up on middle, Blackwood slinks down the wicket and slams it over mid-wicket for a boundary. These two have looked aggressive against the spinners.
Floated on middle, Blackwood comes forward and defends it with his bat and pad together. Stifled appeal turned down.
This time Brathwaite gets it past the bowler for a single to long off.
Another one on off, Brathwaite looks to hammer it down but again finds the bowler.
Brathwaite comes down and hammers it back down the wicket.
Shorter outside off, Brathwaite looks to cut but is beaten by the low bounce.
On a length outside off, placed behind covers for a run.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite looks to defend but gets a leading edge towards mid off.
Fuller on off, Blackwood drives it on the up through covers. Yasir Shah again gives it a chase and hauls it back in time and saves a run for his side.
Shorter outside off, Blackwood defends it off the outer half of the bat from his crease. Yasir Shah gives it a chase at point and keeps them to a couple.

Stays outside off, on a length from round the wicket, left alone.
This is short again, Brathwaite goes back and pushes this off the back foot into covers but not for any runs.
Brathwaite comes forward and defends it.
Too close to cut! Drops this on off, skids on, Brathwaite looks to cut off his back foot but ends up chopping it towards the off side.
On off, pushed towards Misbah by Brathwaite taking a couple of steps down.
Drives this down to long off for a run.
FOUR! In the gap! Floated outside off, Blackwood comes down and hits it wide of covers with a wristy drive. The ball beats Babar coming across from long off and goes into the fence.
Goes round the wicket, hurls it fuller outside off, Brathwaite comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Full again on middle, goes away just a touch, Brathwaite defends it back down the wicket.
FOUR! EDGED! Bowls it outside off on a length, Brathwaite looks to defend but does so off the outer half of the bat through the gap between second slip and gully for a boundary.
Fuller in length on middle, kept out by Brathwaite.
Fuller outside off, Brathwaite blocks it.
Begins with a fuller one on off, Brathwaite defends it from his crease.
MOHAMMAD AMIR to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Hit away! Drops this short on off, spins away a touch, Blackwood does well to pull it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter outside off, cut towards covers by Blackwood.
Floated on middle, Blackwood comes forward and defends it.
Short again outside off, punched to covers by Blackwood.
Blackwood pulls this towards mid-wicket but not in the gap.
Shorter one outside off, pushed through covers by Blackwood.

Welcome back for the second session of play! Pakistan are sitting pretty at the moment but they'll know that they have to keep chipping away at the wickets. West Indies need a partnership to get their innings on track. YASIR SHAH to begin proceedings after lunch.
....DAY 2...SESSION 2....

The spinners came on and disaster struck for West Indies. Bravo was caught superbly by Amir at covers while trying to go after Babar. Yasir Shah then came into the game, trapping Samuels right in front to reduce West Indies to 38 for 3. The home side is right in front here and will be wanting to stay on top by taking wickets at regular intervals. The visitors once again are behind in the game and have a lot to do. Join us in a while for the second session.

What a riveting session of Test cricket! First the Windies wrapped up the tail in time to get batting. Leon Johnson was snared early but the pair of Bravo and Brathwaite fought hard. Bravo was tested by short balls from the pacers in Riaz and Amir but he survived those.
Very full and outside off, Brathwaite jams it out towards short cover. THAT SHALL BE LUNCH ON DAY 2.
Drifting in on a length outside off, defended off the back foot to the covers.
Fuller on middle, gets across and blocks it out down the track.
Drifting in from around off, another solid front foot defense from KB.
Fired fuller on off, Brathwaite gets across and blocks.
Full and outside off, Brathwaite squeezes it out to short cover.
Floated on off, Blackwood gets the stride in and defends it well.
Full on off, Blackwood leans into it and defends it out solidly.
JERMAINE BLACKWOOD walks out to bat.

OUT! YASIR GETS INTO THE ACT! Drifting in on off, Samuels was playing for the turn but this doesn't quite spin much. Skids through to ping him on the front pad. The lbw appeal is given by the umpire quickly. Marlon wants to review it. Is there an inside edge? Nothing at all on the replays and looks like he is a goner. Over to the Hawk Eye now. Impact in line and hitting middle and off. Another big strike for Pakistan.
Samuels has been given out lbw. He goes for the review immediately.
Slider outside off, Samuels defends it well from the crease.
Tossed up outside off, Samuels gets forward and blocks it out.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.

FOUR! TOP SHOT! Fuller on off, Brathwaite steps out to that one and launches it over mid on. Clean strike and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary. Positive stroke from Kraigg. He's using his feet well.
Fuller on off, KB jams it out back to the bowler.
Drifting in from outside off, jabbed off the back foot to point.
Darts it in on off, angling in, Brathwaite blocks it firmly off the back foot.
Fired in on off, pushed from the crease to the covers.
Very full on middle, Samuels gets forward and blocks it out.
A bit short and outside off, punched off the back foot to cover.
Floated just around off, Samuels gets well forward and blocks it.
Tossed up outside off, Samuels reaches out and blocks it to the covers.
Drifting in on middle, Brathwaite steps out and digs it out to mid off. Single taken.
Flatter and full, dug out back to the bowler.
Slider outside off, pushed towards point.
Fired in around leg stump, Brathwaite misses the flick but is struck on the pad. The ball rolls to FSL.
Flatter on off, pushed off the back foot to the covers. Single taken.
MARLON SAMUELS walks out to bat.

OUT! STUNNER FROM AMIR! What an way to take your first catch in Tests! Took him 20 matches to grab one. Floated just outside off, Bravo looks to play the lofted stroke but miscues it high just over the covers. Amir was running with his back to the ball and then dives to take the ball midair before landing safely. Exceptional catch and that's a huge blow for the Windies as the in-form Bravo has to go.
Drifting in from around off, Brathwaite steps out again and this time drives it towards wide mid off for a single.
Floated on off, steps out and pushes it towards mid on.
ZULFIQAR BABAR comes on to bowl.
Floats it up on middle and off, DB gets across and defends it nicely.
Flatter on off, Bravo stays back and blocks it towards the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, worked towards short leg who gets a hand to parry it towards the short mid-wicket region.
Drifting in on off, turns in a bit as Bravo covers the line to block. Just got his bat down in time.
Tossed up around off, defended firmly off the front foot down the track.
Floated on middle, Bravo clips it with the turn towards leg gully where it is well stopped.
YASIR SHAH comes into the attack.
On a length outside off, blocked off the back foot down the track.
Good length ball outside off, pushed towards the covers.
Length ball outside off, blocked off the back foot to silly mid off.
Full and outside off, mistimes the drive towards the covers.
Length ball outside off, defended from the crease towards silly mid off.
Length ball on leg stump, Brathwaite shuffles and clips it through backward square leg for a brace.
Back of a length outside off, Bravo hangs back and blocks it well.
Full outside off, Bravo gets on the front foot and blocks it to cover.
Full and angled in on off, moves across and blocks it out well.
Once again the length is short but this is going harmlessly down the leg side. Bravo ducks.
Dug in short around off, not much bounce this time as Bravo sways away from the line.
Short ball from Amir and Bravo calmly ducks under the bumper.
Length ball on off, Bravo tries to push at it but gets it off the inside half through backward square leg for a single.
Full and down the leg side, Bravo looks to flick it away but misses.
As expected, more of the short stuff for Bravo and he ducks this time.
Leg gully comes in place now.
Dug in short around leg stump, cramps up Bravo who looks to work it on the leg side. Bobbles up in the air for a while but falls safe. Came off the ribs probably.
Good length angled away outside off, Brathwaite plays with an angled bat. Gully and point both dive one after the other but the ball sneaks through. A single taken.
Full and outside off, Brathwaite mistimes the drive towards mid off.
Slower ball on the pads, Brathwaite clips it past mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball angled in from outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
Switches to around the wicket.
Back of a length on off, Bravo shuffles across and tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Brathwaite hangs back and jabs it to cover-point for a single.
Length ball on middle, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and around off, slower ball and Bravo is early on the drive. Miscues it in the air but just wide of Amir's reach as it goes to mid on. Almost a return catch.

FOUR! NICELY DONE! Short around leg stump, Brathwaite goes back and across to ride the bounce well. Works it around the corner towards the fine leg fence for a boundary. Very delicately played leg glance.
Length ball outside off, Brathwaite gets half-forward and punches it to mid off.
Dug in short on middle stump line, Brathwaite ducks under it.
Full and outside off, beautiful front foot drive from Brathwaite but straight to the fielder at mid off.
Good length just outside off, Kraigg shuffles and blocks it out.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards cover-point.
Full and around off, Bravo gets across and clips it towards mid on.
A good bouncer around off, Bravo ducks under it convincingly this time.
Short of a length around off, Bravo gets back to fend it but gets it off the toe end on to the pitch.
Full and around leg stump, Bravo misses the flick. Good take by Sarfraz diving to his right.

FOUR! SPANKED! Bravo is off the blocks quickly. Back of a length outside off, stands tall and punches it sweetly on the up through the covers. Once again, the timing is key as it speeds away to the ropes.
Good length outside off, jammed off the back foot to cover for a single.
Banged in short again just outside off, Bravo seems uncomfortable to the rising ball and makes a weird leave.

Four Leg byes! Dug in short around off, Bravo awkwardly tries to duck with his bat hanging. Takes his eyes off the ball and is struck on the back of the neck. Rebounds off his body down to the fine leg fence.
Length ball outside off, jabs off the back foot towards mid off.

FOUR! SHOT! What a way to get off the mark! Fullish on off, angling in, Bravo nonchalantly flicks it away sweetly through mid-wicket. That races away like a bullet to the fence despite the slow outfield. Excellent shot by the southpaw.
DARREN BRAVO is the new man in.

OUT! WAHAB STRIKES! Good length around off, nips in a touch as Johnson plays across to that one. Misses to be rapped on the front pad. Huge appeal for lbw and the umpire's finger goes up straightaway. That looked quite plumb to the naked eye. Johnson after a chat with his partner, decides to walk away without taking the review.
Good length outside off, Johnson lets it pass to the keeper.
Bowls it outside off, Brathwaite comes forward and defends it.
Slanted on a fuller length outside off, left alone by Brathwaite.
On the pads, on a length, Brathwaite tucks it towards square leg.
Johnson clips it through backward square leg for a single. The umpire signals it a leg bye. That was the attempted inswinger.
Slants this one on the pads, Johnson fails to clip it. The ball flies to the right of Sarfraz who dives and stops the ball.
Bowls it on off, Johnson pushes it with a straight bat to mid on.
Fuller on the stumps, Johnson pushes it down the ground through mid on for a single.
Outside off on a length, Brathwaite pushes it to covers for a quick single.
On a length on the pads, tucked to square leg for a couple of runs.
Brathwaite turns this one towards the on side.
An unofficial warning for Riaz already for following through in the danger area!
Brathwaite gets behind the line and pushes this one towards mid off.
A touch short outside off, Brathwaite punches it to mid off.
WAHAB RIAZ to bowl from the other end.
Bring this one a touch in after pitching, Johnson has read it well and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Johnson is not interested.
On a length outside off, Johnson defends it back down the wicket.
Another one that swings away, a bit more fuller, Johnson this time plays inside the line and  is beaten.
Bowls an outswinger outside off, Johnson feels for it, pushes it bat at it but is beaten all ends up.
Fuller on middle, swings in, Brathwaite clips it through mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
